entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Zhou Tai, courtesy name Youping, was a military general serving under the warlord Sun Quan during the late Eastern Han dynasty and early Three Kingdoms period of China, playing a pivotal role in the Battle of Red Cliffs that would determine the fate of the region.






Zhou Tai, previously serving under Sun Ce, Sun Quan's elder brother and predecessor, was instrumental in the early campaigns of Sun Quan, securing crucial victories that would pave the way for the eventual establishment of the Eastern Wu state.






As a prominent military leader, Zhou Tai's actions would have a lasting impact on the region, shaping the course of Chinese history and leaving a lasting legacy in the annals of the Three Kingdoms period.






The intricate web of alliances and rivalries that defined the Three Kingdoms period would be forever altered by the strategic decisions of Zhou Tai, cementing his place as one of the most significant figures of the era.
